messages:
Ava: Morning team  I'm starting on Wed as a contractor on the runtime team. Quick checklist Qs: 1) Do contractors get a company laptop shipped by default? 2) Which security trainings are mandatory in week 1 and are there any synchronous-only sessions I should know about? 3) Are contractors included in phishing sims or delayed until week 2?

Marta (people-ops): Welcome Ava! Contractors typically get a loaner unless your contract says bring-your-own. We'll request one for you now. Mandatory items: SecureStart (online, ~45m) and the 10-min phishing micro-course. No mandatory live-only sessions in week 1; all live onboarding sessions are recorded.

Ravi (it-support): Hi Ava  We'll ship a MacBook Air M1 or similar depending on stock. Please fill the device request form: https://redwood.example.com/device-requests and include your postal address. If you prefer to use your personal device, it must be enrolled in our MDM and meet baseline: FileVault on, OS latest minor patch, SSO enabled. Commands to verify FileVault: `fdesetup status`.

Noah (security): Adding: contractors must enroll devices in MDM and use the company password vault for any company credentials. We don't exclude contractors from phishing sims; however new joiners are given a one-off grace where the first simulated phish won't affect their security score. If you want to opt into early security office hours for a walkthrough, ping me and I can set up a 20-min slot.

Ava: Thanks all  I'm remote in EMEA so shipping ETA matters. Also curious: do contractors get access to the staging clusters right away or is that gated on training completion?

Ravi (it-support): Shipping ETA depends on carrier to EMEA, usually 3-7 business days from fulfillment. We'll send tracking once packed. For MDM enrollment, watch for an email with a QR and the enrollment link. Staging access is usually provisioned after account activation, but elevated infra perms may require manager approval and training completion; that's handled by the runtime team admin.

Marta (people-ops): I'll set the SecureStart due date to 5 days post-account activation. @onboard-bot could you tag this thread 'contractor-onboard-device' and set a reminder in 4 days for follow-up on laptop shipping?

onboard-bot: Reminder 'contractor-onboard-device' created for 4d.

Ava: Perfect, thanks. One more: who do I contact if MDM enrollment fails? Last time on another job the profile install hung 

Ravi (it-support): Open a ticket to it-support@redwood.example.com and include a screenshot of the enrollment error and the device serial number if possible. We can also do a remote Zoom session to walk through. If the device shows 'enrollment pending' in the admin console, try reconnecting to the network and wait five minutes before escalating.

Noah (security): Also ensure Personal Hotspot is off while enrolling  some carriers block profile downloads. If you plan to use 1Password personally, we'll issue a company 1Password invite and create a team vault; please don't store company secrets in personal accounts.

Marta (people-ops): Looping here: device request submitted for Ava, SecureStart training set, reminder scheduled. Welcome aboard and ping me if shipping doesn't appear in 48h. :tada:
